page.name: Med Spa — approved facts
page.audience: Med spa owners and practice managers
page.headline: iThinq AI Voice Assistant for med spas
page.subheadline: Answering, intake and follow-up for inbound calls.

disclosure.text: This page is shared by an independent iThinq AI Partner, who may be compensated if you become a customer.

sections.heading: Situation
sections.body: Calls arrive while the team is with clients.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Enquiries that are not answered are not captured.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body: Answers inbound calls. Takes the caller through the questions the team would ask about a consultation enquiry. Captures the enquiry and hands it back in a form the practice can act on. Asks the same questions in the same order whoever is on shift. Keeps follow-up moving after the call has ended. Answers calls outside opening hours where the setup supports it, which depends on how it is configured.

sections.heading: Who it is for
items: It is built for service businesses that take enquiries and bookings over the phone.
Med spas and aesthetics clinics are a target market.
Typical callers are prospective patients enquiring about a consultation.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.body: Helps with the enquiries around care rather than giving clinical advice. Does not replace the people who take the conversations that need a person. The product is shown on a demo call before a practice commits to it.

qa.question: Does it replace the team?
qa.answer: Does not replace the people who take the conversations that need a person.

qa.question: Does it answer out of hours?
qa.answer: Answers calls outside opening hours where the setup supports it, which depends on how it is configured.

qa.question: How is it evaluated?
qa.answer: The product is shown on a demo call before a practice commits to it.

qa.question: What is it?
qa.answer: The iThinq AI Voice Assistant is an AI voice assistant that handles inbound phone calls for a business.
